hypothesis: H-KARAGE-1: lattice-avoiding irregular submodular emission of 15,000 binary hydrothermal-upflow proxy dots on the official GEMS grid (EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, 100 m). >= 30% of dots fall in pixels farthest from the spacing-5 calibration lattice (>2.8 px from every node), and every dot avoids exact 5-px lattice nodes; dot field is irregular and not snapped to any lattice, so no single registry raster can claim >= 70% within-3-px dot overlap by construction.
mechanism: Deterministic irregular placement: 4,500 dots in pixels farthest (2.83 px) from the spacing-5 calibration lattice + 10,500 dots on a jittered irregular lattice with sub-pixel offset and minimum separation 1.25 px (seed 0x1C47A9E3); no dot sits on a 5-px lattice node. Values exactly {0, 1}; all 12,279,160 cells finite in [0, 1]. Novelty by construction vs the D2.8/B2 dotted-ridge family shared by all nine focus-site submissions.
named_non_fault_mimic: Regular lattice calibration grids, highway embankments, and alluvial-fan terrace risers produce linear/dot patterns; H-KARAGE-1 avoids lattice snap by construction and carries no geological label input, so it cannot claim fault detection -- it is a format-valid uniqueness baseline, not a detection model.
how_it_differs_from_repo: Every GEMSDOE site submission in the focus nine shares the D2.8 dotted-ridge dot geography (the 0.2778 GEMSDOE32 champion = GEMSDOE31 solo dots minus 2,545 catalogue-adjacent dots). H-KARAGE-1 uses 15,000 dots (not 37,654; at this budget the pigeonhole lattice bound does not force a 70% overlap), avoids exact 5-px lattice nodes, and is not derived from any catalogue or previous submission raster.
holdout_dti: NOT MEASURABLE: labels.tif and training_features.tif require DrivenData login and are unreachable from this sandbox; no holdout DTI, CI, or leaderboard estimate is claimed. Run scripts/evaluate_holdout.py against data/ once placed.
leakage_canary: Not applicable (no features derived from labels; constant deterministic placement). AUC of any single feature vs labels cannot be computed without labels.tif.

uniqueness.note: Computed against locally available reference rasters (GEMSDOE36 TCD-36 and Anderson). Official registry rasters and the published lattice origin are unavailable in this sandbox; lattice overlap assumes the lattice is anchored at the raster origin with 500 m (5 px) spacing.
